record.name: LiveAgent
record.one_liner: LiveAgent provides an all-in-one customer service platform with ticketing, live chat, and call center capabilities, accessible via a public REST API authenticated with API keys.

auth.notes: API requests require an apikey parameter or can be authenticated using an API key passed in requests.

access.notes: Users can sign up for a 30-day free trial without a credit card and obtain API access through their account.

api_surface.notes: The API reference covers REST endpoints for agents, companies, conversations, customers, and files.

mcp.notes: No Model ContextProtocol (MCP) is mentioned in the documentation.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve trial accounts are easily available, and a complete API reference with code examples is documented.

evidence.claim: LiveAgent offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required.
Provides a complete API reference documenting agents, companies, conversations, and parameters including API key authentication.
